units.source_text: 阿民盘膝而坐，抱着膝盖，冷冷的嘲讽。

en.t: Amin sat cross-legged, hugging her knees, and sneered coldly.

units.source_text: 猛然被戳破心中所想的阿住，忍不住摘下自己的眼镜。

en.t: Azhu, whose thoughts had suddenly been exposed, could not help taking off her glasses.

units.source_text: 至于摘下眼镜的原因，她自己也不明白。

en.t: As for why she had taken off her glasses, she did not understand it herself.
